title: lychnis furcata subsp. elatior
intro: Lychnis furcata subsp. elatior, commonly known as Giant Mullein, is a biennial plant species belonging to the Lythraceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Giant Mullein include soothing respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, and its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and alkaloids, are responsible for these effects. Additionally, the plant's leaves and flowers are rich in mucilages, which contribute to its soothing and protective properties.
